title: Algorithmic Hiring and Diversity: Reducing Human-Algorithm Similarity for Better Outcomes
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on gender diversity in algorithmic hiring.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its analysis is focused exclusively on gender as a protected attribute in the context of algorithmic hiring.
